content.title: FSS Q3 Deep Dive: Backlog Transition and Aftermarket Drive Guidance Amid Market Skepticism
content.summary: Safety and security company Federal Signal (NYSE:FSS) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 17% year on year to $555 million. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $2.12 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.14 per share was 5.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Federal Signal (FSS): Five-Year Earnings Growth Deceleration Raises Valuation Debate
content.summary: Federal Signal (FSS) posted another year of high-quality numbers, with earnings growing at an average annual rate of 21.2% over the past five years. However, that pace cooled to 9.6% in the most recent year. The company’s net profit margin held steady at 11.2%, while the outlook calls for earnings growth of 11.85% and revenue growth of 10.8% per year.
